verdict.rationale: LightSprint turns plain-English requests into tasks. It can create tasks directly from Slack, Linear or Jira with two-way sync, and for larger features it supports a plan-first flow where options and mockups are chosen before handing off one implementation task. That plan comes close to a proposed scope. However, nothing shows it ingesting user-feedback submissions as such, or automatically converting them into structured tasks with scope. Missing for 10: explicit intake of user feedback (feedback forms, support tickets), automatic structuring of feedback into tasks with proposed scope or acceptance criteria, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
